mapper.select: SELECT encode(id, 'hex') AS "deviceId", device_fingerprint AS "deviceFingerprint", current_score AS "currentScore", risk_level AS "riskLevel", first_seen_at AS "firstSeenAt", last_seen_at AS "lastSeenAt", last_login_ip AS "lastLoginIp", last_ip_seen_at AS "lastIpSeenAt", linked_user_count AS "linkedUserCount", recent_distinct_ip_count AS "recentDistinctIpCount", recent_ip_switch_count AS "recentIpSwitchCount", last_penalty_reason AS "lastPenaltyReason", last_penalty_score AS "lastPenaltyScore", last_penalty_at AS "lastPenaltyAt", used_ip_list AS "usedIpList" FROM device_risk_profile WHERE id = decode(#{deviceIdHex}, 'hex')

SELECT score_before AS "scoreBefore", penalty_score AS "penaltyScore", score_after AS "scoreAfter", reason, created_at AS "createdAt" FROM device_risk_score_event WHERE device_id = decode(#{deviceIdHex}, 'hex') ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
